summary: The clips of “vagn op” from the `tigregotico-vagn_op-da` test set, placed between seconds of Danish speech, followed by 7 hours of read speech, music, household and outdoor sounds and speech in other languages with no wake word. A detector streams every recording and is scored on the wake words it caught and on how often per hour it woke with no wake word.
notes: Built by scripts/publish_ww_stream_bench.py from `tigregotico-vagn_op-da` at TigreGotico/synthetic-wakeword-vagn_op@53d0dc1b (264 of 264 clips with the phrase) and the negatives of `da-DK`. The negatives hold 4 h of read speech, 1 h of music, 1 h of household and outdoor sounds, 1 h of speech in other languages: 7 hours in all.
